program.name: Fun GCAT
program.full_name: Functional Genomic and Computational Assessment of Threats
program.description: Develops rapid assessment methods for DNA sequences to identify biosecurity threats. Creates AI-driven threat screening software to evaluate: organism origin, biological function, and danger level.
key_achievements: 500x improvement in computational efficiency over state-of-the-art
High predictive accuracy on challenging test sets
Stable performance on short sequences (<50 base pairs)
Developed optical, cell-based tests identifying immune system disruptors
Discovered new functions for dozens of virus genes
program.bio_ai_relevance: VERY HIGH — directly at the biosafety+AI intersection: uses neural networks and bioinformatic analysis for DNA threat screening
